title: Wynwood Walls Art District Food Tour
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
All food and drinks are included in the ticket price.
A fascinating cultural narration behind each of the food you will be tasting.
Gratuities for your tour guide (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Taste the cuisine of some of the most celebrated chefs in town at this five-star culinary destination. We are going to make you try the very best bites in our city—all under one roof. No lines, no waiting. 

Experience Miami on a plate at this exclusive culinary experience where you get to taste one-of-a-kind dishes. Get to learn South Florida’s culinary culture from ingredients to cooking techniques. 

Your expert epicurean guide will introduce you to a new world of cuisines and local flavors while covering the culture behind those doing the cooking. Hear the stories of the chefs that put Miami on the map as one of the most thriving culinary destinations in the country.
